calibration_sources: DeepSeek 3FS (Fire-Flyer File System) 180-Node NVMe + 2x200Gbps InfiniBand (6.6 TB/s Aggregate Read) Architecture
CRAQ (Chain Replication with Apportioned Queries) vs Primary-Copy OSD Read Amplification Model
GPUDirect Storage (GDS) & USRBIO User-Space Zero-Copy Ring vs Linux Kernel VFS Page-Cache LRU Contention

workload_baseline.rdma_nic_per_node: 2x 200Gbps RoCEv2 / InfiniBand (7.2 TB/s theoretical line rate)

tiers.name: Tier 1: General-Purpose Enterprise NAS / CephFS over TCP (Kernel VFS + RADOS PG Locking)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 1: 通用企业级 NAS / CephFS (TCP 内核态 VFS + RADOS 强一致锁)
tiers.datapath_architecture: Kernel Socket TCP -> OS Page Cache Copy -> User Buffer -> PCIe Host-to-Device
tiers.replication_and_metadata: Ceph RADOS Primary-Copy (Reads pinned to primary OSD) + Active/Standby MDS

tiers.name: Tier 2: Traditional HPC Parallel Filesystem (Lustre / BeeGFS over LNet RDMA + OS Page Cache)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 2: 传统超算并行文件系统 (Lustre / BeeGFS + LNet RDMA + 内核 Page Cache)
tiers.datapath_architecture: Kernel LNet RDMA -> Linux Page Cache LRU Thrashing -> User Copy -> CUDA H2D
tiers.replication_and_metadata: Static OST Striping + Centralized MDT (Single-Namespace Inode Lock Bottleneck)

tiers.name: Tier 3: Commercial AI All-Flash SDS (WEKA / VAST Data + DPDK Zero-Copy + GPUDirect Storage)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 3: 商用全闪 AI 软件定义存储 (WEKA / VAST + DPDK 轮询 + GPUDirect Storage)
tiers.datapath_architecture: User-Space DPDK/RDMA Bypass -> GPUDirect Storage (GDS nvidia-fs DMA to GPU HBM)
tiers.replication_and_metadata: Distributed Erasure Coding (N+2/N+4) + Scale-Out Shared-Nothing MetadataContainers

tiers.name: Tier 4: Open-Source DeepSeek 3FS (Fire-Flyer File System: CRAQ Apportioned Reads + USRBIO Zero-Copy RDMA + FoundationDB)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 4: 开源 DeepSeek 3FS (CRAQ 链式均摊读 + USRBIO 零拷贝异步环 + FoundationDB 元数据)
tiers.datapath_architecture: Page-Cache-Free O_DIRECT + Linux io_uring + USRBIO Shared-Memory Ring + RDMA Write/Read
tiers.replication_and_metadata: CRAQ (Chain Replication with Apportioned Queries: All replicas serve reads) + FoundationDB SSI
